datasets.title: Satellite detected water extent in Riosucio Municipality, Chocó Department, Colombia as of 17 November 2024
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20241112COL, GDACS ID: 1102988 This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in Riosucio Municipality, Chocó Department, Colombia as observed from a TanDEM-X radar image acquired on the 17 November 2024. Within the analysed area of about 1,130km², a total of about 12 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Important note: Flood analysis based on radar images may underestimate the extent of standing water in built-up or densely vegetated areas due to the radar signal's backscattering properties.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-in-riosucio-municipality-choco-department-colombia-as-of-17-november-2024]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: TanDEM-X radar imagery acquired on 17 November 2024 was analyzed by UNOSAT analysts through multi-temporal comparison with reference imagery to detect notable changes in water extent. Satellite-detected inundated areas were delineated and quantified as approximately 12 km² within the 1,130 km² study area of Riosucio Municipality. This is a preliminary post-event empirical hazard assessment not yet validated in the field.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite-based flood extent mapping using TanDEM-X radar imagery and multi-temporal image analysis to detect water surface changes and delineate inundated areas
